Class Game

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.model.Game
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Game extends Object implements Serializable
The Game class manages the entire game process, including player actions, deck management, and game phases. It handles trucker movements, card effects, and the overall game state.
